method: Hopper pseudo-C cross-checked against nm, Objective-C metadata, and otool disassembly

confirmed.finding: Scan queue permits six concurrent PMR operations
Main scan dispatcher enqueues PMR work only; the PMR operation requires nonzero declared item count before folder listing
Database readers use NSData buffers and direct offset/property access; item records retain selected fields and copied PMR slices
Ordinary PMR enrichment uses the MDB reader object when present; without it, existing unnamed files can enter an optional ScanMXF-gated fallback
MDB matching uses an eight-byte UID key extracted at identity offset 16
Ordinary AVB filtering uses raw marker scanning with eight-byte media identifiers
Action queue is serial; Delete tries system Trash and has an optional permanent-delete fallback

currentMediaMuster: PMR/MDB input is already buffered in RAM; old claims of repeated database-file seeks are obsolete.
Ordinary table rows already discard full scan/evidence ownership after preparation.
Database and media candidate acquisition loops remain sequential.
Physical discovery is independent of database membership.
Header scheduling requires more complete qualified fields and can open headers for missing Source Path.
Temporary typed property/object/projection/evidence work remains before compact row delivery.
Whole Bin filtering follows actual root-listed object relationships.
Scan progress emits an event per source/file; disk diagnostics flush each write.
limits: No MDVx workload was executed and no comparative runtime benchmark was run.
Decompiler output is approximate pseudo-C; variable types and register expressions can be wrong.
Inspected paths do not establish exhaustive correctness, malformed-input safety, or coverage of all workflows.
Six is a configured scan-operation maximum, not a guarantee of six active threads or a sixfold speedup.
No app-specific MDVx persisted operation recovery, latest-job Undo or Rebalance equivalent was identified; absence is not formally proven.
The method named OMFiTOCReader02 reports unsupported based on a Bento-container version branch; this does not independently prove all OMF revision-2 schema support is absent.
evidenceStorage: Raw Hopper pseudo-C and disassembly were captured in temporary local directories during the 18 October inspection. These paths may expire; retained records identify the binary, methods and verified conclusions.

mdvxIdentityFollowup.conclusion: MDVx stores full modern IDs but compares an eight-byte excerpt for MDB and ordinary bin matching. Ordinary duplicate-row equality also requires the same path.
